description_en: Retrieves the details of one or more documents in a specified category
description_zh: 获取指定类目下一个或多个文档的详细信息
name: ListFile

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID to which the category belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 类目所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

The category ID, which is the `CategoryId` returned by the AddCategory operation. You can also obtain it on the Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - Files tab by clicking the ID icon next to the category name.

</props>

<props="intl">

The category ID, which is the `CategoryId` returned by the AddCategory operation. You can also obtain it on the Application Data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - Files tab by clicking the ID icon next to the category name.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

类目 ID，即 AddCategory 接口返回的`CategoryId`。您也可以在应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签，单击类目名称旁的 ID 图标获取。

</props>

<props="intl">

类目 ID，即 AddCategory 接口返回的`CategoryId`。您也可以在应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签，单击类目名称旁的 ID 图标获取。

parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 200.

Default value:
If no value is set or the value is less than 1, the default value is 20. If the value is set to greater than 200, the default value is 200
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。取值范围[1-200]。

默认值：
当不设置值或设置的值小于 1 时，默认值为20。当设置的值大于 200 时，默认值为 200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The file name (without extension). Only exact match is supported. Fuzzy search is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称（不含后缀），仅支持按照文件名精准查找，不支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The list of file IDs to query. A maximum of 20 files can be queried at a time
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的文件id列表，单次查询最多支持20个文件
parameters.name: file_ids

Data.description_en: The data field returned by the operation

FileList.description_en: The list of files in the category

CategoryId.description_en: The ID of the category to which the file belongs

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the file was added to Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Time zone: UTC+8
CreateTime.description_zh: 文件实际添加到阿里云百炼中的时间戳，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，时区：UTC + 8

FileId.description_en: The file ID, which is the `FileId` returned by the AddFile operation. You can also obtain it on the <props="china">Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">Application Data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props> page by clicking the icon next to the file name
FileId.description_zh: 文件 ID，即 AddFile 接口返回的`FileId`。您也可以在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>页面，单击文件名称旁的图标获取

FileType.description_en: The file format type. Valid values: pdf, docx, doc, txt, md, pptx, ppt, xlsx, xls, html, png, jpg, jpeg, bmp, and gif

Parser.description_en:
The document parser. Valid values:
DASHSCOPE_DOCMIND: Alibaba Cloud intelligent document parsing
Parser.description_zh:
文档解析器。可能值为：
DASHSCOPE_DOCMIND：阿里云文档智能解析

Status.description_en:
The file parsing status. Valid values:
INIT: Initialization state. Waiting to be scheduled.
PARSING: Parsing in progress.
PARSE_SUCCESS: Parsing completed.
PARSE_FAILED: Parsing failed
Status.description_zh:
文件解析状态，可能值为：
INIT: 初始化状态，等待调度中。
PARSING: 解析中。
PARSE_SUCCESS：解析完成。
PARSE_FAILED：解析失败

Tags.description_en: The list of tags associated with the file. A document can be associated with multiple tags
Tags.description_zh: 文件关联的标签列表，一个文档支持关联多个标签

HasNext.description_en:
Indicates whether there is a next page of category data that matches the query conditions. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
HasNext.description_zh:
符合查询条件的类目数据是否存在下一页，可能值为：
true：是。
false：否

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned by this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the returned results

Status.description_en: The status code returned by the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful. 
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功。 
false：失败
